approvers: my tax adviser, my bank, and my family
reason: A Belize shell with no track record and no committed funding is not who I hand my life's work and my twenty people to. I want the highest cash at closing from a buyer I can check, and 30% spread over three years from an unknown company is a risk I will not take.
objection: Belize holding, no money committed, no history. If the funding falls through I have lost a year and my staff have heard about it.
instead: Keep running the business, list it on nexxt-change, or talk to a known buyer or a competitor who pays more cash at closing.
would_change_my_mind: Proof of funds verified by my bank, a German or EU entity with named people I can meet, references from sellers they have already bought from, and a higher share paid in cash at closing.
